Transformation Matrix 3D TRANSFORMATION (x',y',z') (x,y,z) Operates on: 3D World Space Representation: 4x4 Homogeneous A transformation matrix is a mathematical map that encodes exactly how to warp, rotate, scale, or shear a 2D coordinate space. When you multiply an original coordinate vector by this matrix, it calculates the new, transformed location of that point. 5.1 The Anatomy of a 2x2 Transformation Matrix The transformation matrix is composed of two distinct vectors, but to visualize how it alters space, you must read the matrix vertically as columns, rather than horizontally as rows. The two column vectors tell you exactly where the foundational axes of the entire grid end up after the transformation . FAST NUCES - Karachi Talha Shahid 8
